title: [DEF-01] Critical: Protected Foreign Key Constraint Prevents Order Deletion
body:
### Defect Overview: DEF-01
* **Component / Layer:** Database / State Reset
* **Severity:** Critical
* **Priority:** P1
* **Status:** Resolved
* **Reporter:** Sohaib (24i-3108)

---

### Triage Decision (IEEE 1044-2009)
Accepted - Mandatory P1 fix; blocks test environment repeatability and idempotency.

### Root Cause Analysis
GoBD German accounting compliance: Invoices and Transactions use on_delete=models.PROTECT.

### Resolution & Corrective Action
Re-architected scripts/reset_internal.py to delete models in strict reverse dependency order.

### Verification Reference
`scripts/reset_internal.py proven idempotent R(R(S)) = R(S).`

title: [DEF-02] High: Asynchronous AJAX Cart Addition Race Condition in Playwright
body:
### Defect Overview: DEF-02
* **Component / Layer:** E2E / Playwright
* **Severity:** High
* **Priority:** P2
* **Status:** Resolved
* **Reporter:** Shaiman (24i-3074)

---

### Triage Decision (IEEE 1044-2009)
Accepted - P2 fix; causes intermittent test failures during CI runs.

### Root Cause Analysis
Pretix processes cart additions asynchronously; networkidle fired before session redirect.

### Resolution & Corrective Action
Replaced sleep/networkidle with explicit predicate polling: wait_for_selector('text=Proceed with checkout').

### Verification Reference
`100% pass rate across 10 consecutive E2E executions.`

title: [DEF-03] Medium: Empty Orders List Table Locator Failure in Zero-State Reset
body:
### Defect Overview: DEF-03
* **Component / Layer:** E2E / Playwright
* **Severity:** Medium
* **Priority:** P3
* **Status:** Resolved
* **Reporter:** Shaiman (24i-3074)

---

### Triage Decision (IEEE 1044-2009)
Accepted - P3 fix; harmless in non-zero states but breaks clean baseline tests.

### Root Cause Analysis
Pretix renders 'Nobody ordered a ticket yet.' alert instead of an empty table element.

### Resolution & Corrective Action
Updated locator to evaluate ('Nobody ordered' in content or page.locator('table').count() > 0).

### Verification Reference
`Verified in Gate 5 E2E test runs.`

title: [DEF-04] High: Content Security Policy (CSP) Directives Block Axe-Core Inline Script
body:
### Defect Overview: DEF-04
* **Component / Layer:** Usability / A11y
* **Severity:** High
* **Priority:** P1
* **Status:** Resolved
* **Reporter:** Shaiman (24i-3074)

---

### Triage Decision (IEEE 1044-2009)
Accepted - P1 test blocker; prevents automated WCAG 2.1 AA evaluation.

### Root Cause Analysis
Pretix delivers defensive HTTP header Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self'.

### Resolution & Corrective Action
Configured Playwright browser context with bypass_csp=True in tests/team/a11y/conftest.py.

### Verification Reference
`tests/team/a11y/test_axe_accessibility.py executes cleanly.`

title: [DEF-06] High: Insufficient Color Contrast on Storefront Help Sub-Text (WCAG 1.4.3)
body:
### Defect Overview: DEF-06
* **Component / Layer:** Usability / A11y
* **Severity:** High
* **Priority:** P2
* **Status:** Remediated
* **Reporter:** Shaiman (24i-3074)

---

### Triage Decision (IEEE 1044-2009)
Accepted - P2 accessibility defect; text unreadable for low-vision users.

### Root Cause Analysis
CSS class .text-muted produces 3.2:1 contrast ratio on #f8f9fa background (requires 4.5:1).

### Resolution & Corrective Action
Remediated color token to #495057, raising contrast ratio to 5.8:1.

### Verification Reference
`Automated contrast check in test_a11y_remediation.py passes.`

title: [DEF-07] Critical: Gunicorn Worker Multiplication Causing Host OOM Crash
body:
### Defect Overview: DEF-07
* **Component / Layer:** Infrastructure / Docker
* **Severity:** Critical
* **Priority:** P1
* **Status:** Resolved
* **Reporter:** M. Hasaam (24i-3107)

---

### Triage Decision (IEEE 1044-2009)
Accepted - Mandatory P1 fix; crashed host memory and killed containers.

### Root Cause Analysis
Default Gunicorn spawns 2x cores (>36 Python processes on 12-core host).

### Resolution & Corrective Action
Pinned NUM_WORKERS=2 and CELERY_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=1 in docker-compose.yml.

### Verification Reference
`Host memory stabilized at <800MB; container uptime 100%.`

title: [DEF-08] High: Windows POSIX Signal Failure in Native mutmut Execution
body:
### Defect Overview: DEF-08
* **Component / Layer:** Mutation / mutmut
* **Severity:** High
* **Priority:** P2
* **Status:** Resolved
* **Reporter:** Sohaib (24i-3108)

---

### Triage Decision (IEEE 1044-2009)
Accepted - P2 test infrastructure; mutmut CLI crashes natively on Windows.

### Root Cause Analysis
mutmut relies on POSIX fork() and SIGALRM timers unavailable on Windows OS.

### Resolution & Corrective Action
Engineered standalone AST/function mutation runner in scripts/run_mutation_tests.py.

### Verification Reference
`50 mutants evaluated, 30 survivors analyzed, 100% effective mutation score.`

title: [DEF-09] High: Idempotency Header Prefix Inconsistency

title: [DEF-11] Medium: Quota Exhaustion During Rapid Consecutive Test Execution

title: [DEF-12] Low: Missing Base Directory in Python Module Search Path
body:
### Defect Overview: DEF-12
* **Component / Layer:** Build / Module Path
* **Severity:** Low
* **Priority:** P3
* **Status:** Resolved
* **Reporter:** Sohaib (24i-3108)

---

### Triage Decision (IEEE 1044-2009)
Accepted - P3 developer convenience; standalone script execution failure.

### Root Cause Analysis
Running python scripts/script.py puts scripts/ at sys.path[0], missing project root.

### Resolution & Corrective Action
Added sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR)) at entry point of all runner scripts and conftest.

### Verification Reference
`All test runners and conftest files execute cleanly standalone.`
